subject: MedNexus activation: owner assignment, timelines, and runbook
body:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedNexus — post-signature activation + quick owner ask

Mina, team —

Happy to report MedNexus signed this morning (final e-sign attached). Quick context so CS can own the activation:

- Contract value: $420k ARR (first-year commit)
- Initial scope: hosted API + dedicated capacity for two dev environments, 1 production cluster reserved (p4d-like)
- Target go-live: phased rollouts starting week of May 24 (UAT), production target June 14
- Key success metrics: 99th pct latency <350ms for 512-token requests, steady-state throughput 120 reqs/s for the primary model
- Security: they requested SOC2 evidence, KMS integration, and private peering options (see attached questionnaire)

Attachments: [MedNexus_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (PDF)] [mednexus_deployment_requirements.xlsx (XLSX)] [redwood_runbook_template.md (MD)]

Action items for CS to pick up:
1) Assign primary CSM and secondary (on-call)
2) Confirm kickoff meeting invite (60–75 min) with MedNexus technical leads + procurement
3) Validate SOW schedule and escalate any redlines to me
4) Collect environment/peering details (VPN / VPC CIDR, firewall contacts) — this is the blocking item for Dedicated capacity provisioning

Notes for background: procurement wants a single PO; they may push billing to quarterly in year 1 — we should decide if we accept quarterly with a credit card hold — I flagged for finance but wanted CS to be aware.

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0187

On Thu, 29 Apr 2027 at 11:03 AM Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedNexus — post-signature activation + quick owner ask

Thanks Marissa — congrats on the close.

I will take primary ownership for the activation and named CSM. Evelyn, can you be the secondary/on-call for the first 90 days? If yes, I will send an intro and kickoff invite today.

Quick notes after a skim of the attachments:
- SOW: timeline looks OK but we should add a 2-week buffer between UAT and production for capacity tuning and regression evaluation.
- Deployment spreadsheet: we need the pre-prod VPC ranges and the contact for their network ops to open the peering ticket.
- Runbook: I'll populate the attached redwood_runbook_template.md with initial milestones and owner assignments and share a link.

Proposed kickoff times (PT): Mon May 4, 10:00am–11:15 or Tue May 5, 2:00pm–3:15. Marissa — could you confirm the MedNexus attendees and preferred time?

Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0144

On Thu, 29 Apr 2027 at 12:29 PM Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 12:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MedNexus — post-signature activation + quick owner ask

Adding a few technical items I think CS will want to surface and confirm at kickoff:

- Model variant: MedNexus signed for "rw-instruct-large-v2" with 8-bit quantization for non-prod and float16 for prod. We should confirm token limits for batch sizing.
- Expected peak sequence length: they said 1024 tokens in some prompts; we'll need to benchmark to confirm latency targets.
- KV cache retention: recommend enabling prefix caching for session continuity; may require extra memory reservation on dedicated nodes.
- Networking: we need NAT/egress requirements for telemetry and telemetry IP allowlist (we can provide a CIDR range).
- Data residency: they asked for EU data retention rules for a subset of logs — they mentioned their EU customers will be routed to an EU tenant later this year. For now region is US; note this in runbook.

I'll prepare a short environment checklist and a minimal test plan to validate latency/throughput during UAT. I can be at the kickoff if it's within my calendar.

Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com

Subject: Re: MedNexus — post-signature activation + quick owner ask

Thanks all — excited to get started. The morning of May 5 (PT) works best for our engineers; they'd prefer 10:30am PT if possible. Proposed attendees from our side: myself (prod owner), Tom Liu (platform lead), Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@mednexus.com> (network ops), and procurement (TBD).

We will fill out the deployment spreadsheet and send the network contact by EOD tomorrow. For the SOW, procurement prefers billing to be quarterly for year 1; I'll include that in the procurement thread but we can discuss at kickoff.

Attached: signed_cover_page.pdf (attachment stub)

Elena Garcia

- Owners: Mina (primary CSM), Evelyn (secondary/on-call), Dev (implementation lead), Marissa (account exec escalation).
- Pre-kickoff deliverables due May 3: network contact + CIDR ranges, signed SOW (we have e-sign cover page, procurement to confirm PO cadence), expected test data set for UAT (anonymized).

Mina
